```python
class Cat(Node):
    __slots__ = ('kids','offs','fkids','foffs')
    def __init__(self, kids):
        # direct kids (no nested Cats spliced)
        total=0; acc=0; offs=[0]
        for kid in kids:
            acc = (acc*p257(kid.n) + kid.h) & MASK
            total += kid.n; offs.append(total)
        Node.__init__(self, total, acc)
        self.kids = kids; self.offs = offs; self.fkids = None; self.foffs = None
    def flat(self):
        if self.fkids is None:
            kids=[]; offs=[0]; total=0
            stack=[iter(self.kids)]
            while stack:
                try: it = next(stack[-1])
                except StopIteration: stack.pop(); continue
                if type(it) is Cat:
                    stack.append(iter(it.kids))
                else:
                    kids.append(it); total += it.n; offs.append(total)
            self.fkids = kids; self.foffs = offs
        return self.fkids, self.foffs
```
